notes.title: VirtualHere Client updated to 5.5.8
notes.notes: The virtualhere client was updated from 5.0.0 to 5.5.8 for better compatibility and bug fixes.

notes.title: VirtualHere now integrated with Steam Link Raspberry Pi build
notes.notes:
VirtualHere is now integrated into the Steam Link Raspberry Pi Edition.

So if you own VirtualHere already you have access to this platform now as well, (for no additional charge)

The Pi3 has a quad-core fast CPU and VirtualHere runs well on it.

notes.title: VirtualHere now available on Android
notes.notes:
Anyone who owns VirtualHere for Steam Link automatically gets access to VirtualHere for Android for no extra cost.

VirtualHere for Android provides the same functionality as the Steamlink version, but runs on Android and works together with the new Steam Link Android App.

Just download VirtualHere from the Play Store https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.virtualhere.androidserver

When installed, the Steam Link Android App will detect VirtualHere functionality and add the VirtualHere option to the Settings menu.  Then it works just like before. 

Most Android devices have a better CPU than the Steam Link so performance should be pretty good!

notes.title: Updated VirtualHere Client to 4.3.7
notes.notes:
This version has the following changes

1. Compatible with T300RS wheel
2. The virtualhere drivers are now Microsoft Quality Certified and signed with their certificate
3. Fixed a potential BSOD
4. Fixed an issue with microphone ghosting if the connection is dropped while recording
5. Pulled support for mac osx for the time being
